en-US.name: Android
en-US.description: Android development tools for building, running, and inspecting devices.
en-US.settings.taskPresentation.label: Task presentation
en-US.settings.taskPresentation.description: Choose the task tree shown in the Tasks tool window.
en-US.authorization.workspaceTrust.label: Trust Gradle tasks in this workspace
en-US.authorization.workspaceTrust.description: Allow this plugin to run reviewed Gradle tasks in the current workspace. Turning this off also clears remembered task confirmations.
en-US.authorization.rememberTask.label: Do not ask again for this exact Gradle task
en-US.authorization.rememberTask.description: The approval is limited to this workspace and the current executable and arguments. Changes require confirmation again.

zh-CN.name: Android

zh-CN.device.error.discovery: 无法发现 Android 设备。
zh-CN.settings.taskPresentation.label: 任务展示方式
zh-CN.settings.taskPresentation.description: 选择任务窗口中显示的任务树。
zh-CN.authorization.workspaceTrust.label: 信任此工作区中的 Gradle 任务
zh-CN.authorization.workspaceTrust.description: 允许此插件在当前工作区运行经过审核的 Gradle 任务。关闭后也会清除已记住的任务确认。
zh-CN.authorization.rememberTask.label: 不再询问这个精确的 Gradle 任务
zh-CN.authorization.rememberTask.description: 授权仅限当前工作区以及当前可执行文件和参数；发生变化时会重新询问。
